boundaries: Browser-native input is opt-in with textInputHost: browser; existing Canvas behavior remains the default.
Native iOS owns UIKit/keyboard APIs; Engine contains no Native SDK imports.
RTL is logical text/grapheme editing; complete bidirectional layout and shaping are not added.
Keyboard reveal uses existing scroll containers and field scrolling; fixed custom layouts must respond to surface-relative inset notifications.
G13 owns formal named exports, public package integration and inclusion of the full Unicode notice inside the future npm package. The private transfer includes the associated notice.
No formal performance, release or physical-device qualification is inferred from these correctness checks.
